Keep guest hand towels and washcloths neatly within reach right at the sink with a freestanding guest towel holder that adds classic style to your countertop in Pink, which brings playful, modern energy to bathroom design, offering a fresh take on hardware that celebrates individuality.

Highlights:
- Pink transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Place it anywhere you need it: countertop, freestanding design requires no mounting
- Stable, everyday use: heavy base resists tipping in busy bathrooms
- Coordinate your space: part of the Carolina collection for matching Carolina and other classic bath accessories

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: guest towel holder stand (freestanding towel holder)
- Material: brass construction
- Mounting type: countertop
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 16.3 x 14 x 5.5 inches
- Available size: 11 Inch
- Weight capacity: 20 lb
- Assembly required: no
- Included: freestanding towel holder
- Style: traditional
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
